comparison.objective: Open a sliding door after clearing a block from its track; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Identify and lift an obstruction, then hand off long-range sliding between arms without derailment, versus fine hex/collar manipulation and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Door must reach within 2 cm of the end stop, remain in its track, and leave the block safely on the table; candidate requires two non-bottoming force-bounded stops.
comparison.reason: Obstacle diagnosis and long-travel door handling are materially different from damper adjustment.
